title: Accuracy and Uncertainty in Machine Deception Detection (Research White Paper)
abstract: arXiv:2610.15314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A deception detector is only as useful as the trust its alarms deserve. Like a polygraph, detectors that read a language model's internal activations can catch deceptive responses that look honest. Yet current detectors depend on which layers they read, weaken on broader tests, and do not state how certain their alarms are. This white paper proposes the Machine Deception Detector, which targets both detection accuracy and the uncertainty of detector scores. The detector reads every layer of the language model, learns which tokens carry evidence of deception using only response labels, and calibrates its alarm threshold so that its false--positive rate stays below a prescribed level. An ensemble of such detectors measures the uncertainty of each score and raises an alarm only when its members agree, with a confidence level that sets how certain each alarm must be. The proposed evaluation trains on instructed honest and deceptive stateme

translated_title: 机器欺骗检测中的准确性与不确定性（研究白皮书）
translated_abstract: 欺骗检测器的有用性取决于其警报是否值得信任。就像测谎仪一样，读取语言模型内部激活的检测器能够捕获那些表面上看起来诚实的欺骗性响应。然而，当前的检测器依赖于所读取的特定层，在更广泛的测试中性能会减弱，并且不会说明其警报的确定程度。本白皮书提出了机器欺骗检测器，同时针对检测精度和检测器分数的不确定性。该检测器读取语言模型的每一层，仅使用响应标签来学习哪些 token 携带欺骗证据，并校准其警报阈值，使假阳性率保持在规定水平以下。由多个此类检测器组成的集成系统可以测量每个分数的不确定性，并且仅在其成员达成一致时才发出警报，同时通过置信水平来设定每个警报必须达到的确定程度。所提出的评估方法在指示的诚实和欺骗性陈述上进行训练……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本白皮书提出机器欺骗检测器，通过读取语言模型全部层、校准警报阈值以控制假阳性率，并利用集成检测器量化不确定性，从而在保证检测准确性的同时使每个警报都具有可量化的置信度。
